/-! ## The shared preservation argument (§57, §69, §70) -/

/-- Releasing authorities and marking places dead, then releasing the authorities whose holder
died, preserves `KInv` (§57), provided the death markers respect parts (§49.2), usable places keep
only valid former anchors (§52, §44), the root authorities of usable root places are kept (§49.7),
no authority made inactive keeps an active descendant (§69.2, §70.3, last sentences; so that the
origin of an active authority stays active, §51), and `NoDangling` (§54) holds afterwards. -/
theorem releases_preserve {s s₁ : S3} (hk : KInv s) (hr : OnlyReleases s s₁)
    (hP : s₁.P = s.P) (hF : s₁.F = s.F) (hn : s₁.nF = s.nF)
    (hd : ∀ q, s₁.dead q = false → s.dead q = false)
    (hparts : ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (r : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.parent = some r →
      s₁.dead r = s₁.dead q)
    (hD : ∀ q, s₁.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s₁.D q, x ∈ s.D q)
    (hI3 : ∀ q, s₁.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s₁.D q, (cleanup s₁).Active x)
    (hroot : ∀ (r i : Nat) (z : Authority) (pr : Place), RootPlace s.P r → s₁.Usable r →
      s.A[i]? = some z → z.active = true → z.origin = none → s.P[r]? = some pr →
      z.holder = pr.owner → (∀ l, l ∈ z.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P r) → s₁.A[i]? = some z)
    (hkept : ∀ a b, s.Active a → ¬ (cleanup s₁).Active a → a ∈ s.ancs b →
      ¬ (cleanup s₁).Active b)

theorem endUse_preserves {k : K} {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} (hk : KInv s)
    (h : EndUseStep k p s (.ok s')) : KInv s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h

  refine releases_preserve hk (endUseS_releases s p) rfl rfl rfl
    (fun q h => by simp only [endUseS, Bool.or_eq_false_iff] at h; exact h.1)
    (fun q pl r hq hp => ?_) (fun q _ x hx => ?_) (endUse_anchors hk.2.1.1.2.2.1 hpre)
    (fun r i z pr _ hur hz _ _ hpr hzh _ => ?_)
    (kept_of_range ((endUseS_releases s p).trans (cleanup_releases _)) hpre.keptDesc)
    (endUse_noDangling hw hk.2.1.2.2 hk.2.1.1.1 hpre)

    simp only [endUseS, hd, decide_eq_decide.2 (ownedIn_parent hw hq hp)]
  · simp only [endUseS] at hx; split at hx

theorem transfer_preserves_wf3_inv3 {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hinv : KInv s)

/-- Auxiliary invariant, not a clause of §57 nor of §63: every active derived
authority held by a usable place is among the anchors of that place (§44). `store` (§65) adds
the stored authority to the anchors of its target, and the `ok` effect of §63 moves an
authority held by a part `r` of the source together with the anchors of `r`. -/
def HeldAnchored (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority) (q : Nat), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true → y.origin ≠ none →
    y.holder = .place q → s.Usable q → x ∈ s.D q

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44, §54) after an accepted transfer, under `HeldAnchored`: a moved held
authority is checked by §63.7; an unmoved derived one is an anchor of its unmoved holder,
checked by `AnchorOrder` in the resulting state (§63.6); an unmoved root authority is its own
effective anchor, held by the place. -/
private theorem transfer_anchorOrderHeld {k : K} {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s)
    (hheld : HeldAnchored s) (hpre : TransferPre k s src dst) :
    AnchorOrderHeld (transferEff s src dst) := by
  intro q hq x y hy ya hh
  have hy' := hy
  rw [transfer_A_get] at hy
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy
  by_cases hm : AnchorMoves s src x
  · have e := hpre.anchorOrderHeld x (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy₀)) hm q
      (List.mem_range.2 (by rw [← transfer_len s src dst]; exact hq.lt)) hq
    rw [hy'] at e
    exact e ya hh
  · have hmv : ¬ HolderMoves s src y₀.holder := by
      unfold AnchorMoves at hm; rw [hy₀] at hm; exact hm
    have hnh : ¬ heldIn s.P src y₀.holder := by
      cases e : y₀.holder with
      | frame g => simp [heldIn]
      | place p => rw [e] at hmv; exact fun h => hmv (.inl h)
    simp only [hnh, ↓reduceIte] at ya hh hy'
    have hqs : ¬ partOf s.P q src := by rw [hh] at hmv; exact fun h => hmv (.inl h)
    cases ho : y₀.origin with
    | none =>
      have hex : (transferEff s src dst).effAnchor x = x := by
        have : (transferEff s src dst).org x = none := by simp [S3.org, hy', ho]
        simp [S3.effAnchor, S3.ancs, chain_none this]
      obtain ⟨f, hf, hfF⟩ := hq.frameOf
      unfold EffAnchorOK
      rw [hex, hy', pframe_iff.2 hf]
      simp only [OptP, hh, S3.hframe, pframe_iff.2 hf]
      exact ancestor_self hfF
    | some o =>
      have hxq := hheld x y₀ q hy₀ ya (by rw [ho]; exact fun h => by cases h) hh
        (transfer_usable_back hwf hpre.srcUsable hq)
      have hxq' : x ∈ (transferEff s src dst).D q := by
        rw [transfer_D]; simp only [hqs, ↓reduceIte]; exact List.mem_append_left _ hxq
      exact hpre.anchorOrder q hq x hxq'

/-- An accepted transfer preserves `HeldAnchored` (§44; §63 `ok` effect, second and fourth items):
an authority held by a part `r` of the source moves to `corr(r)` together with the anchors of
`r`; the other holders and their anchors are unchanged. -/
theorem transfer_preserves_heldAnchored {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s)
    (hheld : HeldAnchored s) (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) : HeldAnchored s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  intro x y q hy ya ho hh hq
  rw [transfer_A_get] at hy
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy
  have ya₀ : y₀.active = true := by split at ya <;> exact ya
  have ho₀ : y₀.origin ≠ none := by split at ho <;> exact ho
  by_cases hc : heldIn s.P src y₀.holder
  · simp only [hc, ↓reduceIte] at hh
    cases e : y₀.holder with
    | frame _ => rw [e] at hc; exact hc.elim
    | place r =>
      rw [e] at hc hh
      obtain ⟨r', hcr, -⟩ :=
        optP_false_iff.1 (hpre.sameShape.1 r (List.mem_range.2 hc.1) hc)
      simp only [mvTo, hcr, Option.getD_some, Holder.place.injEq] at hh
      subst hh
      have hr' := corr_partOf hwf hpre.dstUsable.lt (r + 1) r r' (Nat.lt_succ_self r) hcr
      have hxr := hheld x y₀ r hy₀ ya₀ ho₀ e
        (usable_of_partOf hwf (r + 1) r src (Nat.lt_succ_self r) hc hpre.srcUsable)
      rw [transfer_D]; simp only [not_partOf_src hwf hpre.disjoint hr', ↓reduceIte]
      exact List.mem_append_right _ (mem_movedTo.2 ⟨r, hc, hcr, hxr⟩)
  · simp only [hc, ↓reduceIte] at hh
    have hqs : ¬ partOf s.P q src := by rw [hh] at hc; exact hc
    have hxq := hheld x y₀ q hy₀ ya₀ ho₀ hh (transfer_usable_back hwf hpre.srcUsable hq)
    rw [transfer_D]; simp only [hqs, ↓reduceIte]
    exact List.mem_append_left _ hxq

/-- On a state satisfying `KInv` and the auxiliary `HeldAnchored`, an accepted transfer preserves
`KInv` (§57; §63). `HeldAnchored` is not a clause of §57: `transfer_preserves_of_dst_usable_fails`
shows that `KInv ∧ KAux` does not suffice on states not built by kernel steps. -/

    (hheld : HeldAnchored s) (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) : KInv s' := by
  obtain ⟨hw', hi', -⟩ := transfer_preserves_wf3_inv3 hinv h
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact kInv_of hw' hi' (transfer_anchorOrderHeld hinv.1 hheld hpre)

/-! ## O1 `derive` (§60) -/

/-- `derive` preserves `WF3` (§49, §60): the new authority has an existing source, a footprint
within the footprint of the source (§49.4: leaves), a live holder (§60.4), and no root authority
changes (§49.7). -/
theorem derive_preserves_wf3 {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {region : List Nat} {m : Mode} (hw : WF3 s)
    (h : DeriveStep src region m s (.ok s')) : WF3 s' := by
  obtain ⟨hp, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨x, hx, -⟩ := hp.active
  exact addAuth_wf3 hw hx (fun p hp' => afp_eq hx ▸ hp.within p hp') hp.frameLive

/-- `derive` preserves I1 (§50, §60.2, §60.3), under I1 alone: the requested mode is permitted by
the effective mode of the source on every leaf of the region. -/
theorem derive_preserves_exclusivity {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {region : List Nat} {m : Mode}
    (h1 : I1 s) (h : DeriveStep src region m s (.ok s')) : I1 s' := by
  obtain ⟨hp, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨x, hx, -⟩ := hp.active
  exact addAuth_I1 h1 hx hp.modeOK

/-- `derive` preserves I2 (§51, §60.1, §60.2): the derived mode does not exceed the own mode of the
source, whatever the region, the region is within the footprint of the source, and the source,
origin of the new active authority, is active. -/
theorem derive_preserves_i2 {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {region : List Nat} {m : Mode} (h2 : I2 s)
    (h : DeriveStep src region m s (.ok s')) : I2 s' := by
  obtain ⟨hp, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨x, hx, xa, hm⟩ := exercisableAt_mode hp.exercisable
  exact addAuth_i2 h2 hx xa hm fun p hp' => afp_eq hx ▸ hp.within p hp'

/-- `derive` preserves I3 (§52, §60 effect: no anchor is created or removed). -/
theorem derive_preserves_i3 {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {region : List Nat} {m : Mode} (h3 : I3 s)
    (h : DeriveStep src region m s (.ok s')) : I3 s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact addAuth_i3 h3 _

/-- `derive` preserves `AnchorOrder` (§44, §54, §60 effect). -/
theorem derive_preserves_anchorOrder {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {region : List Nat} {m : Mode}
    (hao : AnchorOrder s) (h : DeriveStep src region m s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrder s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact addAuth_anchorOrder hao _

/-- `derive` preserves `NoDangling` (§54, §60.2): the region is within the footprint of the active
source. -/
theorem derive_preserves_noDangling {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {region : List Nat} {m : Mode}
    (hnd : NoDangling s) (h : DeriveStep src region m s (.ok s')) : NoDangling s' := by
  obtain ⟨hp, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨x, hx, xa⟩ := hp.active
  exact addAuth_noDangling hnd hx xa fun p hp' => afp_eq hx ▸ hp.within p hp'

/-- `derive` preserves `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44, §54, §60.4): the new authority is held by the
current frame. -/
theorem derive_preserves_anchorOrderHeld {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {region : List Nat} {m : Mode}
    (haoh : AnchorOrderHeld s) (h : DeriveStep src region m s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrderHeld s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact addAuth_anchorOrderHeld haoh rfl

/-- `derive` preserves the auxiliary `RootHeldConv` (§40, §49.7, §60 effect: the new authority has
an origin). -/
theorem derive_preserves_rootHeldConv {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {region : List Nat} {m : Mode}
    (hc : RootHeldConv s) (h : DeriveStep src region m s (.ok s')) : RootHeldConv s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact addAuth_rootHeldConv hc rfl

/-- `derive` preserves the kernel invariant `KInv` (§57, §58, §60); the auxiliary `KAux` is
preserved by `derive_preserves_rootHeldConv`. -/
theorem derive_preserves {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {region : List Nat} {m : Mode} (hinv : KInv s)
    (h : DeriveStep src region m s (.ok s')) : KInv s' := by
  obtain ⟨hw, ⟨⟨h1, h2, h3, -⟩, hao, hnd⟩, haoh, -⟩ := hinv
  exact kInv_of (derive_preserves_wf3 hw h)
    ⟨⟨derive_preserves_exclusivity h1 h, derive_preserves_i2 h2 h, derive_preserves_i3 h3 h,
      i4_always _⟩, derive_preserves_anchorOrder hao h, derive_preserves_noDangling hnd h⟩
    (derive_preserves_anchorOrderHeld haoh h)

/-- `derive` preserves I5 (§57, §60 effect): it keeps the places, the stack, the death markers and
the pinning obligations, with no hypothesis on `K.Pinned`. -/
theorem derive_preserves_i5 {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {region : List Nat} {m : Mode}

/-! ## Effect of `transfer` on anchors, frames and usability (§63) -/

/-- Anchors after a transfer (§63, `ok` effect, fourth item): parts of `src` lose theirs, and
place `q` receives those of every part `r` of `src` with `corr(r) = q`. -/
private theorem transfer_D (s : S3) (src dst q : Nat) : (transferEff s src dst).D q =
    if partOf s.P q src then [] else s.D q ++ movedTo s src dst q := rfl

/-- Membership in `movedTo` (§63, `ok` effect, fourth item). -/
private theorem mem_movedTo {s : S3} {src dst q x : Nat} :
    x ∈ movedTo s src dst q ↔
      ∃ r, partOf s.P r src ∧ corr s.P src dst r = some q ∧ x ∈ s.D r := by
  simp only [movedTo, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range, decide_eq_true_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r, ⟨-, hr, hc⟩, hx⟩; exact ⟨r, hr, hc, hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨r, hr, hc, hx⟩; exact ⟨r, ⟨hr.1, hr, hc⟩, hx⟩

/-- An anchor of a part of `src` is among the dependencies checked by §63.6. -/
private theorem mem_movedDeps_part {s : S3} {src r x : Nat} (hr : partOf s.P r src)
    (hx : x ∈ s.D r) : x ∈ movedDeps s src := by
  simp only [movedDeps, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range, decide_eq_true_eq]
  exact ⟨r, ⟨hr.1, .inl hr⟩, hx⟩

/-- Under `WF3`, a part of `dst` is not a part of `src` when their footprints are disjoint
(§40, §63.3): every place has a leaf. -/
private theorem not_partOf_src {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {src dst r : Nat}
    (hdis : ¬ overlap s.P src dst) (hr : partOf s.P r dst) : ¬ partOf s.P r src := fun hs => by
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := exists_mem_footprint hw (s.P.length - r + 1) r (by omega) hr.1
  exact hdis ⟨l, footprint_sub hw hs hl, footprint_sub hw hr hl⟩

/-- An ownership chain avoiding the storage of `src` is unchanged by the transfer (§40, §63
`ok` effect, third item). -/
private theorem transfer_frameOf_fwd {s : S3} {src dst q f : Nat} (h : FrameOf s q f)
    (hn : ¬ OwnedIn s.P src q) : FrameOf (transferEff s src dst) q f := by
  induction h with
  | @frame q f pl hpl ho =>
    exact .frame (pl := pl) (by rw [transfer_P_get, hpl]; simp [ho, heldIn]) ho
  | @place q o f pl hpl ho hf ih =>
    have h1 : ¬ partOf s.P o src := fun hp => hn (.direct hpl ho hp)
    have h2 : ¬ OwnedIn s.P src o := fun ho' => hn (.step hpl ho ho')
    exact .place (pl := pl) (by rw [transfer_P_get, hpl]; simp [ho, heldIn, h1]) ho (ih h2)

/-- A place usable before the transfer whose ownership chain avoids the storage of `src` stays
usable (§40, §63 `ok` effect, third item). -/
private theorem transfer_usable_unmoved {s : S3} {src dst q : Nat} (h : s.Usable q)
    (hn : ¬ OwnedIn s.P src q) : (transferEff s src dst).Usable q := by
  induction h with
  | @frame q f pl hpl hd ho hf =>
    exact .frame (pl := pl) (by rw [transfer_P_get, hpl]; simp [ho, heldIn]) hd ho hf
  | @place q o pl hpl hd ho _ ih =>
    have h1 : ¬ partOf s.P o src := fun hp => hn (.direct hpl ho hp)
    have h2 : ¬ OwnedIn s.P src o := fun ho' => hn (.step hpl ho ho')
    exact .place (pl := pl) (by rw [transfer_P_get, hpl]; simp [ho, heldIn, h1]) hd ho (ih h2)

/-- The ownership chain of a place after the transfer (§40, §63 `ok` effect, third item): the
former chain if it avoids the storage of `src`; otherwise it goes through the place
corresponding to a part of `src`. -/
private theorem transfer_frameOf_back {s : S3} {src dst q f : Nat}
    (h : FrameOf (transferEff s src dst) q f) :
    (FrameOf s q f ∧ ¬ OwnedIn s.P src q) ∨
      (OwnedIn s.P src q ∧ ∃ r, partOf s.P r src ∧
        FrameOf (transferEff s src dst) ((corr s.P src dst r).getD dst) f) := by
  induction h with
  | @frame q f pl hpl ho =>
    rw [transfer_P_get] at hpl
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hpl; cases hpl
    | some pl₀ =>
      rw [h'] at hpl; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hpl; subst hpl
      split at ho
      · rename_i hh
        obtain ⟨r', e⟩ := mvTo_place (dst := dst) hh
        simp [e] at ho
      · left; refine ⟨.frame h' ho, fun hn => ?_⟩
        cases hn with
        | direct h1 h2 _ => rw [h'] at h1; cases h1; rw [ho] at h2; cases h2
        | step h1 h2 _ => rw [h'] at h1; cases h1; rw [ho] at h2; cases h2
  | @place q o f pl hpl ho hf ih =>
    rw [transfer_P_get] at hpl
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hpl; cases hpl
    | some pl₀ =>
      rw [h'] at hpl; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hpl; subst hpl
      split at ho
      · rename_i hh
        cases hpo : pl₀.owner with
        | frame g => rw [hpo] at hh; exact hh.elim
        | place r =>
          rw [hpo] at hh ho
          simp only [mvTo, Holder.place.injEq] at ho
          exact .inr ⟨.direct h' hpo hh, r, hh, ho ▸ hf⟩
      · rename_i hh
        rcases ih with ⟨hf0, hn⟩ | ⟨ho', hd⟩
        · left; refine ⟨.place h' ho hf0, fun hq => ?_⟩
          cases hq with
          | direct h1 h2 h3 =>
            rw [h'] at h1; cases h1; rw [ho] at h2; cases h2; exact hh (by rw [ho]; exact h3)
          | step h1 h2 h3 => rw [h'] at h1; cases h1; rw [ho] at h2; cases h2; exact hn h3
        · exact .inr ⟨.step h' ho ho', hd⟩

/-- Places with the same owner are owned through the value at `src` together (§40). -/
private theorem ownedIn_of_owner {P : List Place} {src q r : Nat} {pq pr : Place}
    (hq : P[q]? = some pq) (hr : P[r]? = some pr) (ho : pr.owner = pq.owner)
    (h : OwnedIn P src q) : OwnedIn P src r := by
  cases h with
  | direct h1 h2 h3 => rw [hq] at h1; cases h1; exact .direct hr (ho.trans h2) h3
  | step h1 h2 h3 => rw [hq] at h1; cases h1; exact .step hr (ho.trans h2) h3

/-- If a place owned through the value at `src` has a frame after the transfer, the destination
is not owned through that value (§40, §63 `ok` effect, third item): otherwise the chain would
come back to it. -/
private theorem transfer_dst_not_owned {s : S3} {src dst f : Nat} (hw : WF3 s) :
    ∀ {q}, FrameOf (transferEff s src dst) q f → OwnedIn s.P src q → ¬ OwnedIn s.P src dst := by
  intro q h
  induction h with
  | @frame q f pl hpl ho =>
    intro hq _
    rw [transfer_P_get] at hpl
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hpl; cases hpl
    | some pl₀ =>
      rw [h'] at hpl; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hpl; subst hpl
      split at ho
      · rename_i hh
        obtain ⟨r', e⟩ := mvTo_place (dst := dst) hh
        simp [e] at ho
      · cases hq with
        | direct h1 h2 _ => rw [h'] at h1; cases h1; rw [ho] at h2; cases h2
        | step h1 h2 _ => rw [h'] at h1; cases h1; rw [ho] at h2; cases h2
  | @place q o f pl hpl ho hf ih =>
    intro hq hd
    rw [transfer_P_get] at hpl
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hpl; cases hpl
    | some pl₀ =>
      rw [h'] at hpl; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hpl; subst hpl
      split at ho
      · rename_i hh
        obtain ⟨r', e, hr'⟩ := mvTo_part hw hd.lt hh
        simp only [e, Holder.place.injEq] at ho; subst ho
        obtain ⟨pl', pd, hpl', hpd, ho'⟩ := hw.ownerOf hr'
        exact ih (ownedIn_of_owner hpd hpl' ho' hd) hd
      · rename_i hh
        cases hq with
        | direct h1 h2 h3 =>
          rw [h'] at h1; cases h1; rw [ho] at h2; cases h2; exact hh (by rw [ho]; exact h3)
        | step h1 h2 h3 => rw [h'] at h1; cases h1; rw [ho] at h2; cases h2; exact ih h3 hd

/-- The frame of a place whose ownership chain avoids the storage of `src` is unchanged (§40,
`placeFrame`; §63). -/
private theorem transfer_pframe_unmoved {s : S3} {src dst q : Nat} (hn : ¬ OwnedIn s.P src q) :
    (transferEff s src dst).pframe q = s.pframe q :=
  Option.ext fun f => by
    rw [pframe_iff, pframe_iff]
    exact ⟨fun h => (transfer_frameOf_back h).elim (fun h => h.1) (fun h => absurd h.1 hn),
      fun h => transfer_frameOf_fwd h hn⟩

/-- If the destination has a frame after the transfer, it is still usable (§40, §63): its
ownership chain avoids the storage of `src`. -/
private theorem transfer_usable_dst {s : S3} {src dst g : Nat} (hw : WF3 s)
    (hdst : s.Usable dst) (hg : FrameOf (transferEff s src dst) dst g) :
    (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst := by
  rcases transfer_frameOf_back hg with ⟨-, hn⟩ | ⟨ho, -⟩
  · exact transfer_usable_unmoved hdst hn
  · exact absurd ho (transfer_dst_not_owned hw hg ho)

/-- The effective anchor depends only on the origin chain (§44). -/
private theorem effAnchor_congr {s s' : S3} {x : Nat} (h : s'.ancs x = s.ancs x) :
    s'.effAnchor x = s.effAnchor x := by simp only [S3.effAnchor, h]

/-- `EffAnchorOK` carries over between states whose effective anchors have the same holder frame
and whose ancestor relations agree on the target frame (§44). -/
private theorem effAnchorOK_of_same {s s' : S3} {x x' : Nat} {z z' : Authority}
    (hz : s.A[s.effAnchor x]? = some z) (hz' : s'.A[s'.effAnchor x']? = some z')
    (hh : s'.hframe z'.holder = s.hframe z.holder) {fd fd' : Option Nat}
    (hanc : ∀ g f, fd = some f → (ancestor s'.F g f ↔ ancestor s.F g f)) (hfd : fd' = fd) :
    EffAnchorOK s' x' fd' ↔ EffAnchorOK s x fd := by
  rw [hfd]; unfold EffAnchorOK; rw [hz, hz']; simp only [OptP]; rw [hh]
  cases hg : s.hframe z.holder with
  | none => simp
  | some g =>
    cases hf : fd with
    | none => simp
    | some f => simp only; rw [hanc g f hf]

/-- An anchor whose effective anchor does not move with the value keeps its order (§44, §63):
the holder of the effective anchor and its frame are unchanged. -/
private theorem transfer_effAnchorOK_unmoved {s : S3} {src dst x : Nat} {z : Authority}
    (hz : s.A[s.effAnchor x]? = some z) (hm : ¬ AnchorMoves s src (s.effAnchor x))
    (fd : Option Nat) :
    EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x fd ↔ EffAnchorOK s x fd := by
  have hm' : ¬ HolderMoves s src z.holder := by unfold AnchorMoves at hm; rw [hz] at hm; exact hm
  have hnh : ¬ heldIn s.P src z.holder := by
    cases hh : z.holder with
    | frame g => simp [heldIn]
    | place p => rw [hh] at hm'; exact fun h => hm' (.inl h)
  have he : (transferEff s src dst).effAnchor x = s.effAnchor x :=
    effAnchor_congr (by rw [(transfer_skel s src dst).ancs])
  refine effAnchorOK_of_same (z' := z) hz (by rw [he, transfer_A_get, hz]; simp [hnh]) ?_
    (fun _ _ _ => Iff.rfl) rfl
  cases hh : z.holder with
  | frame g => rfl
  | place p =>
    rw [hh] at hm'
    exact transfer_pframe_unmoved (fun ho => hm' (.inr ho))

/-! ## Preservation (§57, §63) -/

/-- §49.7 (`RootHeld`) after a transfer of a usable `src`: the holder of a root authority and the
owner of its root place change together (§40, §63 `ok` effect, third item). -/
private theorem transfer_rootHeld {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hw : WF3 s) (hsrc : s.Usable src) :
    RootHeld (transferEff s src dst) := by
  intro r hrp hur
  have hrp0 : RootPlace s.P r := by
    simpa only [RootPlace, transfer_len, transfer_parentOf] using hrp
  obtain ⟨i, z, pr, hz, za, zo, zm, hpr, hzh, hzf⟩ :=
    hw.rootHeld r hrp0 (transfer_usable_back hw hsrc hur)
  have hf : ∀ l, l ∈ z.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint (transferEff s src dst).P r := fun l => by
    rw [transfer_footprint]; exact hzf l
  by_cases hc : heldIn s.P src z.holder
  · have hc' : heldIn s.P src pr.owner := hzh ▸ hc
    exact ⟨i, { z with holder := mvTo s.P src dst z.holder },
      { pr with owner := mvTo s.P src dst pr.owner },
      by rw [transfer_A_get, hz]; simp [hc], za, zo, zm, by rw [transfer_P_get, hpr]; simp [hc'],
      by simp [hzh], hf⟩
  · have hc' : ¬ heldIn s.P src pr.owner := hzh ▸ hc
    exact ⟨i, z, pr, by rw [transfer_A_get, hz]; simp [hc], za, zo, zm,
      by rw [transfer_P_get, hpr]; simp [hc'], hzh, hf⟩

/-- `KAux` (`RootHeldConv`, §40, §49.7) after a transfer: the holder of a root authority and the
owner of its root place change together (§63 `ok` effect, third item). -/
private theorem transfer_rootHeldConv {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hr : RootHeldConv s) :
    RootHeldConv (transferEff s src dst) := by
  intro x z' l r hx ho hl hrp hlr
  rw [transfer_A_get] at hx
  obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hx
  have ho' : z.origin = none := by split at ho <;> exact ho
  have hl' : l ∈ z.footprint := by split at hl <;> exact hl
  have hrp' : RootPlace s.P r := by
    simpa only [RootPlace, transfer_len, transfer_parentOf] using hrp
  have hlr' : partOf s.P l r := (transfer_partOf s src dst l r).1 hlr
  obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hh⟩ := hr x z l r hz ho' hl' hrp' hlr'
  refine ⟨_, by rw [transfer_P_get, hpr]; rfl, ?_⟩
  by_cases hc : heldIn s.P src pr.owner <;> simp [hc, hh]

/-- `WF3` (§49) after an accepted transfer. Only §49.8 (holder validity) uses §63.9, the
destination usable in the resulting state. -/
private theorem transfer_wf3 {k : K} {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s)
    (hpre : TransferPre k s src dst) : WF3 (transferEff s src dst) := by
  have hd' := hpre.dstUsableAfter
  have sk := transfer_skel s src dst
  have hdl := hpre.dstUsable.lt
  refine ⟨hwf.frames, ?_, ⟨?_, ?_, fun q hq => hq.frameOf⟩, fun a x hx l hl => ?_,
    sk.origins hwf.origins,
    sk.rootChain hwf.rootChain (transfer_len s src dst) (transfer_parentOf s src dst),
    transfer_rootHeld hwf hpre.srcUsable, ?_⟩
  · intro q pl r hq hp
    rw [transfer_P_get] at hq
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hq; cases hq
    | some pl₀ =>
      rw [h'] at hq; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hq; subst hq

    | none => rw [h'] at hq; cases hq
    | some pl₀ =>
      rw [h'] at hq; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hq; subst hq

  · have hq' := transfer_usable_back hwf hpre.srcUsable hq
    refine sk.active.2 ?_
    rw [transfer_D] at hx
    split at hx

theorem op_preserves_heldAnchored {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s)
    (hh : HeldAnchored s) (h : op.Step k s (.ok s')) : HeldAnchored s' := by
  cases op with
  | derive src region m =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    refine heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq => ?_
    rcases addAuth_get hy with ⟨-, hy⟩ | ⟨-, rfl⟩
    · exact .inr ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, hhq, fun _ hx => hx⟩
    · cases hhq
  | split src rs =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    refine heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq => ?_
    rcases getElem?_append_cases hy with hy | hy
    · exact .inr ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, hhq, fun _ hx => hx⟩
    · obtain ⟨r, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hy; cases hhq
  | release a =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    cases hx₀ : s.A[a]? with
    | none => simp only [releaseEff, hx₀]; exact hh
    | some x₀ =>
      rw [releaseEff_eq hx₀]
      refine heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq => ?_
      simp only [set_get (lt_of_getElem? hx₀)] at hy
      split at hy
      · cases hy; cases ya
      · rename_i hax
        refine .inr ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, hhq, fun _ hx => ?_⟩
        simp only
        split
        · exact List.mem_filter.2 ⟨hx, by simpa using fun e => hax e.symm⟩
        · exact hx
  | transfer src dst => exact transfer_preserves_heldAnchored hw hh h
  | depend q₀ x₀ =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    refine heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq => .inr ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, hhq,
      fun _ hx => ?_⟩
    simp only [dependEff]
    split
    · rename_i e; subst e; exact List.mem_append_left _ hx
    · exact hx
  | enter ps ls =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    refine heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq => ?_
    rcases getElem?_append_cases hy with hy | hy
    · rw [getElem?_mapI] at hy
      obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, e⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy
      split at e
      · subst e; cases hhq
      · subst e
        refine .inr ⟨y₀, hy₀, ya, ho, hhq, fun hu hx => ?_⟩
        show x ∈ (if s.P.length ≤ q then [] else s.D q)
        split
        · exact absurd hu.lt (Nat.not_lt.2 ‹_›)
        · exact hx
    · obtain ⟨r, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hy; exact absurd rfl ho
  | exit =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    refine heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq => ?_
    simp only [exitEff, getElem?_mapI, Nat.zero_add] at hy
    obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, e⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy
    unfold exitG at e
    split at e
    · rename_i hsv
      have ya₀ : y₀.active = true := by
        unfold Survives at hsv; rw [hy₀] at hsv; exact hsv.1
      split at e
      · subst e; exact absurd ‹_› ho
      · rename_i o ho₀
        subst e
        refine .inr ⟨y₀, hy₀, ya₀, (by rw [ho₀]; exact fun h => by cases h), hhq, fun _ hx => ?_⟩
        simp only [exitEff]
        refine List.mem_map.2 ⟨x, hx, ?_⟩
        show (firstSurv s s.F.tail (x :: s.ancs x)).getD x = x
        rw [firstSurv, List.find?_cons_of_pos (p := fun z => decide (Survives s s.F.tail z))
          (a := x) (decide_eq_true hsv)]
        rfl
    · subst e; cases ya
  | read a ls =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact hh
  | write a ls =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    exact heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq =>

    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h

    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    exact heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq =>

    obtain ⟨hy₀, hnh, -⟩ := EndFree.endUse_active hy ya
    refine .inr ⟨y, hy₀, ya, ho, hhq, fun _ hx => ?_⟩
    rw [hhq] at hnh
    show x ∈ (if partOf s.P q p then [] else s.D q)
    split
    · exact absurd ‹_› hnh
    · exact hx
  | free p auth =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    refine heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq => ?_
    obtain ⟨hy₀, -, -⟩ := EndFree.free_active hy ya
    exact .inr ⟨y, hy₀, ya, ho, hhq, fun _ hx => hx⟩
  | alloc pr ow ls =>
    cases h with
    | ok _ _ =>
      refine heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq => ?_
      rcases getElem?_append_cases hy with hy | hy
      · refine .inr ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, hhq, fun hu hx => ?_⟩
        show x ∈ (if s.P.length ≤ q then [] else s.D q)
        split
        · exact absurd hu.lt (Nat.not_lt.2 ‹_›)
        · exact hx
      · obtain ⟨r, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hy; exact absurd rfl ho
  | store a p =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    cases hy₁ : s.A[a]? with
    | none => simp only [storeEff, hy₁]; exact hh
    | some y₁ =>
      have heq : storeEff s a p = { s with
          A := s.A.set a { y₁ with holder := .place p }
          D := fun q => if q = p then s.D p ++ [a] else s.D q
          I := fun l => if l = p then .init else s.I l } := by
        simp only [storeEff, hy₁]
      rw [heq]
      refine heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq => ?_
      simp only [set_get (lt_of_getElem? hy₁)] at hy
      split at hy
      · rename_i e; subst e; cases hy
        cases hhq
        exact .inl (by simp)
      · refine .inr ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, hhq, fun _ hx => ?_⟩
        simp only
        split
        · rename_i e; subst e; exact List.mem_append_left _ hx
        · exact hx

/-- The auxiliary `HeldAnchored` (not a clause of §57) is preserved by every kernel step from a
`WF3` state (§44, §49). -/
theorem kstep_preserves_heldAnchored {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (hh : HeldAnchored s)
    (h : KStep k s s') : HeldAnchored s' := by
  obtain ⟨op, hop⟩ := kstep_iff.1 h
  exact op_preserves_heldAnchored hw hh hop

import Ern.Concurrency.Sync

/-!
# Preservation of the re-indexed kernel invariant (WC2 C20, C23)

Theorem 2 of the exploratory pass, except `exitFrameC` and `terminate`: the kernel invariant of
Spec 1 §57 re-indexed (`KInvC`), with the auxiliaries of Spec 1 `reachable_inv` (`KAux`,
`HeldAnchored`) read on the flat state, is preserved by the inherited operations O1–O16 other than
O7 executed by a context (Spec 1 §60–§72, §74, §75; WC2 C2), by `spawn` (WC2 C4), `join` (WC2 C8)
and `deriveSync` (WC2 C15).

The clauses of Spec 1 that read the stack only through membership are obtained from the Spec 1
lemmas on the view of the executing context; the anchor orders are proved on `ancestorC`.
Helper lemmas live in `Ern.Concurrency.PreservationAux`.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-- The inductive invariant of theorem 2 (WC2 C20, C23): `KInvC` (Spec 1 §57 re-indexed) with the
auxiliaries `KAux` and `HeldAnchored` of Spec 1 `reachable_inv`, read on the flat state. -/
def KInvCA (s : SC) : Prop := KInvC s ∧ KAux s.flat ∧ HeldAnchored s.flat

namespace PreservationAux

/-! ## Membership transport (WC2 C2) -/

/-- `HeldAnchored` reads the stack only through membership (Spec 1 §44, §40). -/
theorem heldAnchored_mem_congr {t : S3} {F' : Frames} (h : HeldAnchored t)
    (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ F' ↔ f ∈ t.F) : HeldAnchored { t with F := F' } :=
  fun x y q hy ya ho hh hq => h x y q hy ya ho hh ((usable_mem_congr hF).1 hq)

/-- The kernel facts of Spec 1 on the view of a context, from the re-indexed invariant (WC2
C2). -/
theorem view_facts {s : SC} (hk : KInvCA s) (c : Nat) :
    WF3 (s.view c) ∧ Inv3base (s.view c) ∧ NoDangling (s.view c) ∧ RootHeldConv (s.view c) ∧
      HeldAnchored (s.view c) := by
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨hfr, hw⟩, ⟨⟨h1, h2, h3, -⟩, -, hnd⟩, -, -⟩, hc, hh⟩ := hk
  have hF : ∀ f, f ∈ (s.view c).F ↔ f ∈ s.flat.F := fun f => SC.mem_view_F
  exact ⟨SC.wf3_view hfr hw, ⟨h1, h2, i3_mem_congr h3 hF, i4_always _⟩,
    noDangling_mem_congr hnd hF, hc, heldAnchored_mem_congr hh hF⟩

/-- The flat state of `s'` is `t` with the globally live frames of `s'` (WC2 C2); the kernel
facts of Spec 1 on `t` carry to the flat state of `s'` when `t` lists the same frames. -/
theorem flat_facts {s' : SC} {t : S3} (hflat : s'.flat = { t with F := s'.frames })
    (hmem : ∀ f, f ∈ t.F ↔ f ∈ s'.frames) (hnd : s'.frames.Nodup) (hne : s'.frames ≠ [])
    (hw : WF3 t) (hb : Inv3base t) (hd : NoDangling t) (hc : RootHeldConv t)
    (hh : HeldAnchored t) :
    WF3 s'.flat ∧ I1 s'.flat ∧ I2 s'.flat ∧ I3 s'.flat ∧ NoDangling s'.flat ∧ KAux s'.flat ∧
      HeldAnchored s'.flat := by
  have hF : ∀ f, f ∈ s'.frames ↔ f ∈ t.F := fun f => (hmem f).symm

theorem kInvCA_of {s : SC} (hfr : FramesC s)

      HeldAnchored s.flat) (hao : AnchorOrderC s) (haoh : AnchorOrderHeldC s) : KInvCA s :=
  ⟨⟨⟨hfr, hf.1⟩, ⟨⟨hf.2.1, hf.2.2.1, hf.2.2.2.1, fun _ => i4_always _⟩, hao, hf.2.2.2.2.1⟩,
    haoh, noOrphan_of_wf3 hf.1⟩, hf.2.2.2.2.2.1, hf.2.2.2.2.2.2⟩

theorem frames_ne {s : SC} (hfr : FramesC s) : s.frames ≠ [] := by
  intro he
  have h0 := hfr.initial
  unfold OptP at h0; split at h0
  · rename_i x hx
    have hs := hfr.nonempty 0 (by simp [SC.Live, hx, OptP, h0.1])
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_ne_nil _ hs

theorem effAnchorOKC_of_same {s s' : SC} {x x' : Nat} {z z' : Authority}
    (hz : s.A[s.flat.effAnchor x]? = some z) (hz' : s'.A[s'.flat.effAnchor x']? = some z')
    (hh : s'.flat.hframe z'.holder = s.flat.hframe z.holder) {fd fd' : Option Nat}
    (hanc : ∀ g f, fd = some f → s.ancestorC g f → s'.ancestorC g f) (hfd : fd' = fd)
    (h : EffAnchorOKC s x fd) : EffAnchorOKC s' x' fd' := by
  subst hfd
  unfold EffAnchorOKC at h ⊢
  have hz₁ : s.flat.A[s.flat.effAnchor x]? = some z := hz
  have hz₁' : s'.flat.A[s'.flat.effAnchor x']? = some z' := hz'
  rw [show s.A = s.flat.A from rfl, hz₁] at h
  rw [show s'.A = s'.flat.A from rfl, hz₁']
  simp only [OptP] at h ⊢
  rw [hh]
  revert h
  cases s.flat.hframe z.holder with
  | none => exact id
  | some g =>
    cases hf : fd with
    | none => exact id
    | some f => exact hanc g f hf

  new : ∀ x y', t.A[x]? = some y' → s.A.length ≤ x → ∃ f, y'.holder = .frame f

  obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ : ∃ y', t.A[j]? = some y' :=
    ⟨_, List.getElem?_eq_getElem (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hj h.len)⟩
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, ho, -⟩ := h.old j y' hy' hj

  simp [S3.org, hy', SC.flat, hy, ho]

    (s.set t).flat.Usable q ↔ t.Usable q :=
  usable_mem_congr (t := t) (F' := s.frames) fun f => (hmem f).symm

theorem SkelV.anchorOrderC {s : SC} {t : S3} (h : SkelV s t)
    (hmem : ∀ f, f ∈ t.F ↔ f ∈ s.frames) (h3 : I3 s.flat) (hao : AnchorOrderC s) :
    AnchorOrderC (s.set t) := by
  intro q hq x hx
  have hq' := (set_usable hmem).1 hq
  have hx' := h.D q hq' x hx
  have hqs := h.usable q hq'
  obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := h3 q hqs x hx'
  have hpf : (s.set t).flat.pframe q = s.flat.pframe q := S3.pframe_congr h.P q
  rw [hpf]
  exact h.effAnchorOKC (lt_of_getElem? hy) (hao q hqs x hx')

theorem SkelV.anchorOrderHeldC {s : SC} {t : S3} (h : SkelV s t)
    (hmem : ∀ f, f ∈ t.F ↔ f ∈ s.frames) (haoh : AnchorOrderHeldC s) :
    AnchorOrderHeldC (s.set t) := by

  nonempty := hfr.nonempty
  nodup := hfr.nodup

  rooted := hfr.rooted

    (hsk.anchorOrderHeldC hmem hk.1.2.2.1)

end PreservationAux

end Ern.Concurrency

      HeldAnchored (s.view c) := by
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨hfr, hw⟩, ⟨⟨h1, h2, h3, -⟩, -, hnd⟩, -, -⟩, hc, hh⟩ := hk

    noDangling_mem_congr hnd hF, hc, heldAnchored_mem_congr hh hF⟩

    (hh : HeldAnchored t) :

    haoh, noOrphan_of_wf3 hf.1⟩, hf.2.2.2.2.2.1, hf.2.2.2.2.2.2⟩

    rw [hf] at hh; cases hh

theorem framesC_set {s : SC} {t : S3} (hfr : FramesC s) (hn : t.nF = s.nF) :
    FramesC (s.set t) where
  initial := hfr.initial
  nonempty := hfr.nonempty
  nodup := hfr.nodup
  bound := fun f hf => by show f < t.nF; rw [hn]; exact hfr.bound f hf
  rooted := hfr.rooted
  parent := hfr.parent

re-indexed invariant (WC2 C2, C20). -/

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.Common

/-!
# Preservation by `endUse` (O12, §69) and `free` (O13, §70)

Both effects only make authorities inactive and mark places dead, then release the authorities
whose holder died (§69, §70 `ok` effects). The shared argument is in namespace `EndFree`; the
per-operation results state that each step preserves `KInv` (§57 of
`specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`), separately the auxiliary `KAux` (§40, §49.7) and
`I5` (§57), and the effects of §69 and §70: the ended place stays usable, its leaves become
`Uninit`, transitively owned storage and the released unit are dead, pinned leaves block the step
(§69.4, §70.4).
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

namespace EndFree

/-! ## Authorities that are only released (§69, §70) -/

/-- The authorities of `s₁` are those of `s`, some of them made inactive (§69, §70 `ok` effects:
authorities are released, never created or changed otherwise). -/
def OnlyReleases (s s₁ : S3) : Prop :=
  s₁.A.length = s.A.length ∧ ∀ (j : Nat) (z : Authority), s₁.A[j]? = some z →
    ∃ y, s.A[j]? = some y ∧ z.mode = y.mode ∧ z.origin = y.origin ∧ z.footprint = y.footprint ∧
      z.holder = y.holder ∧ (z.active = true → y.active = true)

/-- Mapping the authorities by a function that keeps an authority or makes it inactive only
releases authorities (§69, §70). -/
theorem map_releases {s s₁ : S3} {g : Authority → Authority} (hA : s₁.A = s.A.map g)
  have cP : (cleanup s₁).P = s.P := hP
  have cF : (cleanup s₁).F = s.F := hF
  have hu : ∀ q, s₁.Usable q → s.Usable q :=
    fun q h => S3.Usable.mono hP (fun f hf => hF ▸ hf) hd h
  have hU := cleanup_usable s₁
  have hw' : WF3 (cleanup s₁) :=
    { frames := by
        show s₁.F ≠ [] ∧ s₁.F.Nodup ∧ ∀ f ∈ s₁.F, f < s₁.nF
        rw [hF, hn]; exact hw.frames
      places := fun q pl r hq hp => by
        rw [cP] at hq
        obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hlt, ho, -⟩ := hw.places q pl r hq hp
        exact ⟨pr, by rw [cP]; exact hpr, hlt, ho, hparts q pl r hq hp⟩
      owners :=
        ⟨fun q pl f hq ho => by
          show f < s₁.nF
          rw [hn]; exact hw.owners.1 q pl f (by rw [← cP]; exact hq) ho,
        fun q pl o hq ho => by
          rw [cP]; exact hw.owners.2.1 q pl o (by rw [← cP]; exact hq) ho,
        fun q hq => hq.frameOf⟩
      footprints := fun a x hx l hl => by
        obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, -, -, e, -⟩ := hc.2 a x hx
        rw [cP]; exact hw.footprints a x₀ hx₀ l (e ▸ hl)
      origins := fun b y a hb ho => by
        obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, -, e, -⟩ := hc.2 b y hb
        exact hw.origins b y₀ a hy₀ (e ▸ ho)
      rootChain := hw.rootChain.transport (by rw [cP]) (by rw [cP]) (fun a => by rw [hc.ancs])
        (fun a y' hy' => by obtain ⟨y, hy, -, -, e, -⟩ := hc.2 a y' hy'; exact ⟨y, hy, e⟩)
        (fun x z hz hzo => by
          obtain ⟨z', hz', -, e1, e2, -⟩ := hc.get' hz
          exact ⟨z', hz', e1.trans hzo, e2⟩)
      rootHeld := fun r hrp hur => by
        rw [cP] at hrp
        have hu₁ := (hU r).1 hur
        obtain ⟨i, z, pr, hz, za, zo, zm, hpr, hh, hf⟩ := hw.rootHeld r hrp (hu r hu₁)
        have hz₁ := hroot r i z pr hrp hu₁ hz za zo hpr hh hf
        have hlive : HolderLive s₁ z.holder := by
          rw [hh]; exact owner_live hu₁ (by rw [hP]; exact hpr)
        refine ⟨i, z, pr, ?_, za, zo, zm, by rw [cP]; exact hpr, hh, by rw [cP]; exact hf⟩
        rw [cleanup_get, hz₁]; simp [hlive]
      holders := fun a y hy ya => by
        obtain ⟨-, hl⟩ := cleanup_active hy ya
        exact (HolderLive.congr (s := s₁) (s' := cleanup s₁) rfl rfl rfl _).2 hl }
  refine kInv_of hw' ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_, i4_always _⟩, ?_, hnd hw'⟩ ?_
  · intro a b x y p hab hx hy xa ya xp yp hnab hnba
    obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, m₁, -, f₁, -, a₁⟩ := hc.2 a x hx
    obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, m₂, -, f₂, -, a₂⟩ := hc.2 b y hy
    rw [hc.ancs] at hnab hnba; rw [m₁, m₂]
    exact i1 a b x₀ y₀ p hab hx₀ hy₀ (a₁ xa) (a₂ ya) (f₁ ▸ xp) (f₂ ▸ yp) hnab hnba
  · intro b y a hb ho
    obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, m₀, e, f₀, -, a₀⟩ := hc.2 b y hb
    obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁, hm, hsub, hact⟩ := i2 b y₀ a hy₀ (e ▸ ho)
    obtain ⟨x', hx', mx, -, fx, -⟩ := hc.get' hx₁
    refine ⟨x', hx', by rw [m₀, mx]; exact hm, fun l hl => by rw [fx]; exact hsub l (f₀ ▸ hl),
      fun ya => ?_⟩
    have hob : s.org b = some a := by simp [S3.org, hy₀, ← e, ho]
    have hab : a ∈ s.ancs b := by
      rw [S3.ancs, chain_cons hob (hw.origins b y₀ a hy₀ (e ▸ ho))]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..
    cases hxa : x'.active
    · refine absurd ⟨y, hb, ya⟩ (hkept a b ⟨x₁, hx₁, hact (a₀ ya)⟩ ?_ hab)
      rintro ⟨x'', hx'', xa⟩
      rw [hx'] at hx''; cases hx''; rw [hxa] at xa; cases xa
    · rfl
  · exact fun q hq x hx => hI3 q ((hU q).1 hq) x hx
  · intro q hq x hx
    have hq₁ := (hU q).1 hq
    refine (hc.effAnchorOK cP cF x _).2 ?_
    rw [S3.pframe_congr cP]
    exact hao q (hu q hq₁) x (hD q hq₁ x hx)
  · intro q hq x y' hx ya hh
    obtain ⟨y, hy, -, -, -, e, ea⟩ := hc.2 x y' hx
    refine (hc.effAnchorOK cP cF x _).2 ?_
    rw [S3.pframe_congr cP]
    exact haoh q (hu q ((hU q).1 hq)) x y hy (ea ya) (e.symm.trans hh)

/-- Releasing authorities with the places unchanged, then releasing the authorities whose holder
died, preserves the auxiliary `KAux` (`RootHeldConv`, §40, §49.7): authorities with no origin keep
their footprint and holder. -/
theorem releases_preserve_kAux {s s₁ : S3} (ha : KAux s) (hr : OnlyReleases s s₁)
    (hP : s₁.P = s.P) : KAux (cleanup s₁) := by
  have hc := hr.trans (cleanup_releases s₁)
  exact RootHeldConv.transport ha hP fun x z' hx ho => by
    obtain ⟨z, hz, -, e1, e2, e3, -⟩ := hc.2 x z' hx
    exact ⟨z, hz, e1 ▸ ho, e2, e3⟩

/-- The kept-descendant check of §69.2 and §70.3 (last sentences), stated on authority

theorem free_preserves {k : K} {s s' : S3} {p auth : Nat} (hk : KInv s)
    (h : FreeStep k p auth s (.ok s')) : KInv s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have hw := hk.1
  have hroot := rootPlace_of_ownedRoot hpre.ownedRoot
  refine releases_preserve hk (freeS_releases s p) rfl rfl rfl
    (fun q h => by simp only [freeS, Bool.or_eq_false_iff] at h; exact h.1)
    (fun q pl r hq hp => ?_) (fun q _ x hx => hx) (free_anchors hk.2.1.1.2.2.1 hpre)
    (fun r i z pr hrp hur hz _ _ hpr hzh hzf => ?_)
    (kept_of_range ((freeS_releases s p).trans (cleanup_releases _)) hpre.keptDesc)
    (free_noDangling hw hk.2.1.2.2 hk.2.1.1.1 hpre)
  · obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hlt, -, hd⟩ := hw.places q pl r hq hp
    have hpo : parentOf s.P q = some r := by simp [parentOf, hq, hp]
    have hf : FreedPlace s.P p r ↔ FreedPlace s.P p q := by
      unfold FreedPlace
      rw [partOf_parent hpo hlt (lt_of_getElem? hpr) hroot.2, ownedIn_parent hw hq hp]
    simp only [freeS, hd, decide_eq_decide.2 hf]
  · have hnf : ¬ FreedPlace s.P p r := fun hf => by
      have := dead_false hur
      simp only [freeS, Bool.or_eq_false_iff, decide_eq_false_iff_not] at this
      exact this.2 hf
    have hc : ¬ ((∃ l ∈ z.footprint, FreedPlace s.P p l) ∨ heldIn s.P p z.holder) := by
      rintro (⟨l, hl, hfl⟩ | hh)
      · obtain ⟨-, -, hlr⟩ := mem_footprint.1 ((hzf l).1 hl)
        rcases hfl with hlp | hown
        · obtain rfl := rootOf_unique hrp hroot hlr hlp
          exact hnf (.inl ⟨hroot.1, .inl rfl⟩)
        · obtain ⟨pl, pr', hpl, hpr', ho⟩ := hw.ownerOf hlr
          exact hnf (.inr (ownedIn_of_owner hpl hpr' ho.symm hown))
      · rw [hzh] at hh
        cases ho : pr.owner with
        | frame f => rw [ho] at hh; exact hh
        | place o => rw [ho] at hh; exact hnf (.inr (.direct hpr ho hh))
    rw [freeS_get, hz]; simp [hc]

/-- `free` preserves the auxiliary `KAux` (`RootHeldConv`, §40, §49.7; O13, §70 `ok` effect:
places are unchanged and authorities are only released). -/
theorem free_preserves_kAux {k : K} {s s' : S3} {p auth : Nat} (ha : KAux s)
    (h : FreeStep k p auth s (.ok s')) : KAux s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact releases_preserve_kAux ha (freeS_releases s p) rfl

/-- `free` preserves `I5` (§57) from a `WF3` state (§49.2: a leaf of a usable place is usable):
a pinned leaf of a usable place belongs to the released unit if it stops being usable, which
§70.4 forbids; the pinning obligations are unchanged (§70 `ok` effect). -/
theorem free_preserves_i5 {k : K} {s s' : S3} {p auth : Nat} (hw : WF3 s) (h5 : I5 k s)
    (h : FreeStep k p auth s (.ok s')) : I5 k s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  intro l hlt hleaf hl
  rw [S3.pin_congr (pins_freeEff s p)] at hl
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hlq⟩ := h5 l hlt hleaf hl
  obtain ⟨hlP, hleaf, hpart⟩ := mem_footprint.1 hlq
  have hlu : s.Usable l := usable_of_partOf hw (l + 1) l q (Nat.lt_succ_self l) hpart hq
  refine ⟨l, (cleanup_usable _ l).2 (Decidable.byContradiction fun hn => ?_),
    mem_footprint.2 ⟨hlP, hleaf, hlP, .inl rfl⟩⟩
  have hn' := hpre.notPinned l (List.mem_range.2 hlP) (.inr ⟨hleaf, hlu, hn⟩)
  rcases hl with e | e

/-- Usability after a step on the view that keeps places and only adds death markers (Spec 1
§40; WC2 C2). -/
theorem usable_back {s : SC} {c : Nat} {t : S3} (hP : t.P = s.P) (hF : t.F = (s.view c).F)
    (hd : ∀ q, t.dead q = false → s.dead q = false) {q : Nat} (h : t.Usable q) :
    s.flat.Usable q :=
  S3.Usable.mono (s' := t) (s := s.flat) hP (fun f hf => SC.mem_view_F.1 (hF ▸ hf)) hd h

/-- Skeleton of a step on the view appending frame-held authorities (Spec 1 §60, §61 `ok`
effects; WC2 C15). -/
theorem skelV_append {s : SC} {c : Nat} {E : List Authority}
    (hE : ∀ y ∈ E, ∃ f, y.holder = .frame f) :
    SkelV s { s.view c with A := (s.view c).A ++ E } where
  P := rfl
  len := by simp [SC.view, SC.flat]
  old := fun x y' hy' hx => ⟨y', by
    have : x < (s.view c).A.length := hx
    simpa [List.getElem?_append_left this] using hy', rfl, rfl, id⟩
  new := fun x y' hy' hx => hE y' (by
    have : (s.view c).A.length ≤ x := hx
    rw [List.getElem?_append_right this] at hy'; exact List.mem_of_getElem? hy')
  usable := fun _ h => usable_back rfl rfl (fun _ h => h) h
  D := fun _ _ _ h => h

/-- Skeleton of a step on the view keeping authorities and anchors (Spec 1 §66–§68, §74, §75 `ok`
effects). -/
theorem skelV_same {s : SC} {c : Nat} {t : S3} (hP : t.P = s.P) (hF : t.F = (s.view c).F)
    (hA : t.A = s.A) (hD : t.D = s.D) (hd : t.dead = s.dead) : SkelV s t where
  P := hP
  len := by rw [hA]
  old := fun x y' hy' _ => ⟨y', by rw [← hA]; exact hy', rfl, rfl, id⟩
  new := fun x y' hy' hx => absurd (lt_of_getElem? hy') (by rw [hA]; omega)
  usable := fun _ h => usable_back hP hF (fun q h' => by rw [← hd]; exact h') h
  D := fun _ _ x hx => by rw [← hD]; exact hx

/-- Skeleton of `release` on the view (Spec 1 §62 `ok` effect). -/
theorem skelV_release {s : SC} {c a : Nat} : SkelV s (releaseEff (s.view c) a) := by
  cases hx₀ : (s.view c).A[a]? with
  | none =>
    simp only [releaseEff, hx₀]
    exact skelV_same rfl rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | some x₀ =>
    rw [releaseEff_eq hx₀]
    have ha : a < s.A.length := lt_of_getElem? hx₀
    refine ⟨rfl, by simp [SC.view, SC.flat], fun x y' hy' _ => ?_, fun x y' hy' hx => ?_,
      fun _ h => usable_back rfl rfl (fun _ h => h) h, fun q _ x hx => ?_⟩
    · simp only [set_get ha] at hy'
      split at hy'
      · rename_i e; subst e; cases hy'
        exact ⟨x₀, hx₀, rfl, rfl, fun h => by cases h⟩
      · exact ⟨y', hy', rfl, rfl, id⟩
    · simp only [set_get ha] at hy'
      split at hy'
      · rename_i e; subst e; omega
      · exact absurd (lt_of_getElem? hy') (by simp [SC.view, SC.flat] at hx ⊢; omega)
    · simp only at hx; split at hx
      · exact (List.mem_filter.1 hx).1
      · exact hx

/-- The `ok` outcomes of the operations that do not read `ancestor` keep the stack and `nF`
(Spec 1 §60–§62, §66–§71, §74, §75 effects). -/
theorem viewOp_FnF {k : K} {t t' : S3} {op : KernelOp} (hop : op.Step k t (.ok t'))
    (hnx : op ≠ .exit) (hne : ∀ ps ls, op ≠ .enter ps ls) : t'.F = t.F ∧ t'.nF = t.nF := by
  cases op with
  | exit => exact absurd rfl hnx
  | enter => exact absurd rfl (hne _ _)
  | transfer => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | depend => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | store => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; unfold storeEff; split <;> exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | derive => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | split => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | release => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; unfold releaseEff; split <;> exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | read => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | write => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | writeShared => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | pin => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | unpin => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | endUse => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | free => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | alloc => cases hop; exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

end PreservationAux

end Ern.Concurrency

theorem viewOp_FnF {k : K} {t t' : S3} {op : KernelOp} (hop : op.Step k t (.ok t'))

  | read => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | write => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | writeShared => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | pin => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | unpin => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | endUse => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | free => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

    rw [allocEff_A hst]; simp

theorem releases_base {s s₁ : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (i1 : I1 s) (i2 : I2 s)

    (hd : ∀ q, s₁.dead q = false → s.dead q = false)
    (hparts : ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (r : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.parent = some r →
      s₁.dead r = s₁.dead q)
    (hI3 : ∀ q, s₁.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s₁.D q, (cleanup s₁).Active x)
    (hroot : ∀ (r i : Nat) (z : Authority) (pr : Place), RootPlace s.P r → s₁.Usable r →
      s.A[i]? = some z → z.active = true → z.origin = none → s.P[r]? = some pr →
      z.holder = pr.owner → (∀ l, l ∈ z.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P r) → s₁.A[i]? = some z)
    (hkept : ∀ a b, s.Active a → ¬ (cleanup s₁).Active a → a ∈ s.ancs b →
      ¬ (cleanup s₁).Active b)

  have hc := hr.trans (cleanup_releases s₁)
  have cP : (cleanup s₁).P = s.P := hP
  have hu : ∀ q, s₁.Usable q → s.Usable q :=
    fun q h => S3.Usable.mono hP (fun f hf => hF ▸ hf) hd h
  have hU := cleanup_usable s₁
  have hw' : WF3 (cleanup s₁) :=
    { frames := by
        show s₁.F ≠ [] ∧ s₁.F.Nodup ∧ ∀ f ∈ s₁.F, f < s₁.nF
        rw [hF, hn]; exact hw.frames
      places := fun q pl r hq hp => by
        rw [cP] at hq
        obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hlt, ho, -⟩ := hw.places q pl r hq hp
        exact ⟨pr, by rw [cP]; exact hpr, hlt, ho, hparts q pl r hq hp⟩
      owners :=
        ⟨fun q pl f hq ho => by
          show f < s₁.nF
          rw [hn]; exact hw.owners.1 q pl f (by rw [← cP]; exact hq) ho,
        fun q pl o hq ho => by
          rw [cP]; exact hw.owners.2.1 q pl o (by rw [← cP]; exact hq) ho,
        fun q hq => hq.frameOf⟩
      footprints := fun a x hx l hl => by
        obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, -, -, e, -⟩ := hc.2 a x hx

      origins := fun b y a hb ho => by
        obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, -, e, -⟩ := hc.2 b y hb

      rootChain := hw.rootChain.transport (by rw [cP]) (by rw [cP]) (fun a => by rw [hc.ancs])
        (fun a y' hy' => by obtain ⟨y, hy, -, -, e, -⟩ := hc.2 a y' hy'; exact ⟨y, hy, e⟩)
        (fun x z hz hzo => by
          obtain ⟨z', hz', -, e1, e2, -⟩ := hc.get' hz

        refine ⟨i, z, pr, ?_, za, zo, zm, by rw [cP]; exact hpr, hh, by rw [cP]; exact hf⟩
        rw [cleanup_get, hz₁]; simp [hlive]

        obtain ⟨-, hl⟩ := cleanup_active hy ya
        exact (HolderLive.congr (s := s₁) (s' := cleanup s₁) rfl rfl rfl _).2 hl }
  refine ⟨hw', ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, i4_always _⟩, hnd hw'⟩

without the anchor orders). -/

section Releases

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access.EndFree

/-- The part of `EndFree.releases_preserve` (Spec 1 §57, §69, §70) that does not concern the anchor
orders: `WF3`, `I1`–`I4` and `NoDangling` after releasing authorities and marking places dead,
from `WF3`, `I1` and `I2` (the proof of `EndFree.releases_preserve` with the `AnchorOrder` and
`AnchorOrderHeld` parts removed). -/
theorem releases_base {s s₁ : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (i1 : I1 s) (i2 : I2 s)
    (hr : OnlyReleases s s₁) (hP : s₁.P = s.P) (hF : s₁.F = s.F) (hn : s₁.nF = s.nF)
    (hd : ∀ q, s₁.dead q = false → s.dead q = false)
    (hparts : ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (r : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.parent = some r →
      s₁.dead r = s₁.dead q)
    (hI3 : ∀ q, s₁.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s₁.D q, (cleanup s₁).Active x)
    (hroot : ∀ (r i : Nat) (z : Authority) (pr : Place), RootPlace s.P r → s₁.Usable r →
      s.A[i]? = some z → z.active = true → z.origin = none → s.P[r]? = some pr →
      z.holder = pr.owner → (∀ l, l ∈ z.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P r) → s₁.A[i]? = some z)
    (hkept : ∀ a b, s.Active a → ¬ (cleanup s₁).Active a → a ∈ s.ancs b →
      ¬ (cleanup s₁).Active b)
    (hnd : WF3 (cleanup s₁) → NoDangling (cleanup s₁)) :
    WF3 (cleanup s₁) ∧ Inv3base (cleanup s₁) ∧ NoDangling (cleanup s₁) := by
  have hc := hr.trans (cleanup_releases s₁)
  have cP : (cleanup s₁).P = s.P := hP
  have hu : ∀ q, s₁.Usable q → s.Usable q :=
    fun q h => S3.Usable.mono hP (fun f hf => hF ▸ hf) hd h
  have hU := cleanup_usable s₁
  have hw' : WF3 (cleanup s₁) :=
    { frames := by
        show s₁.F ≠ [] ∧ s₁.F.Nodup ∧ ∀ f ∈ s₁.F, f < s₁.nF
        rw [hF, hn]; exact hw.frames
      places := fun q pl r hq hp => by
        rw [cP] at hq
        obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hlt, ho, -⟩ := hw.places q pl r hq hp
        exact ⟨pr, by rw [cP]; exact hpr, hlt, ho, hparts q pl r hq hp⟩
      owners :=
        ⟨fun q pl f hq ho => by
          show f < s₁.nF
          rw [hn]; exact hw.owners.1 q pl f (by rw [← cP]; exact hq) ho,
        fun q pl o hq ho => by
          rw [cP]; exact hw.owners.2.1 q pl o (by rw [← cP]; exact hq) ho,
        fun q hq => hq.frameOf⟩
      footprints := fun a x hx l hl => by
        obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, -, -, e, -⟩ := hc.2 a x hx
        rw [cP]; exact hw.footprints a x₀ hx₀ l (e ▸ hl)
      origins := fun b y a hb ho => by
        obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, -, e, -⟩ := hc.2 b y hb
        exact hw.origins b y₀ a hy₀ (e ▸ ho)
      rootChain := hw.rootChain.transport (by rw [cP]) (by rw [cP]) (fun a => by rw [hc.ancs])
        (fun a y' hy' => by obtain ⟨y, hy, -, -, e, -⟩ := hc.2 a y' hy'; exact ⟨y, hy, e⟩)
        (fun x z hz hzo => by
          obtain ⟨z', hz', -, e1, e2, -⟩ := hc.get' hz
          exact ⟨z', hz', e1.trans hzo, e2⟩)
      rootHeld := fun r hrp hur => by
        rw [cP] at hrp
        have hu₁ := (hU r).1 hur
        obtain ⟨i, z, pr, hz, za, zo, zm, hpr, hh, hf⟩ := hw.rootHeld r hrp (hu r hu₁)
        have hz₁ := hroot r i z pr hrp hu₁ hz za zo hpr hh hf
        have hlive : HolderLive s₁ z.holder := by
          rw [hh]; exact owner_live hu₁ (by rw [hP]; exact hpr)
        refine ⟨i, z, pr, ?_, za, zo, zm, by rw [cP]; exact hpr, hh, by rw [cP]; exact hf⟩
        rw [cleanup_get, hz₁]; simp [hlive]
      holders := fun a y hy ya => by
        obtain ⟨-, hl⟩ := cleanup_active hy ya
        exact (HolderLive.congr (s := s₁) (s' := cleanup s₁) rfl rfl rfl _).2 hl }
  refine ⟨hw', ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, i4_always _⟩, hnd hw'⟩
  · intro a b x y p hab hx hy xa ya xp yp hnab hnba
    obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, m₁, -, f₁, -, a₁⟩ := hc.2 a x hx
    obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, m₂, -, f₂, -, a₂⟩ := hc.2 b y hy
    rw [hc.ancs] at hnab hnba; rw [m₁, m₂]
    exact i1 a b x₀ y₀ p hab hx₀ hy₀ (a₁ xa) (a₂ ya) (f₁ ▸ xp) (f₂ ▸ yp) hnab hnba
  · intro b y a hb ho
    obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, m₀, e, f₀, -, a₀⟩ := hc.2 b y hb
    obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁, hm, hsub, hact⟩ := i2 b y₀ a hy₀ (e ▸ ho)
    obtain ⟨x', hx', mx, -, fx, -⟩ := hc.get' hx₁
    refine ⟨x', hx', by rw [m₀, mx]; exact hm, fun l hl => by rw [fx]; exact hsub l (f₀ ▸ hl),
      fun ya => ?_⟩
    have hob : s.org b = some a := by simp [S3.org, hy₀, ← e, ho]
    have hab : a ∈ s.ancs b := by
      rw [S3.ancs, chain_cons hob (hw.origins b y₀ a hy₀ (e ▸ ho))]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..
    cases hxa : x'.active
    · refine absurd ⟨y, hb, ya⟩ (hkept a b ⟨x₁, hx₁, hact (a₀ ya)⟩ ?_ hab)
      rintro ⟨x'', hx'', xa⟩
      rw [hx'] at hx''; cases hx''; rw [hxa] at xa; cases xa
    · rfl
  · exact fun q hq x hx => hI3 q ((hU q).1 hq) x hx

/-- `endUse` preserves `WF3`, `I1`–`I4` and `NoDangling` (Spec 1 §69; the proof of
`endUse_preserves` without the anchor orders). -/
theorem endUse_base {k : K} {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} (hw : WF3 s) (hb : Inv3base s)
    (hnd : NoDangling s) (h : EndUseStep k p s (.ok s')) :
    WF3 s' ∧ Inv3base s' ∧ NoDangling s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  refine releases_base hw hb.1 hb.2.1 (endUseS_releases s p) rfl rfl rfl
    (fun q h => by simp only [endUseS, Bool.or_eq_false_iff] at h; exact h.1)
    (fun q pl r hq hp => ?_) (endUse_anchors hb.2.2.1 hpre)
    (fun r i z pr _ hur hz _ _ hpr hzh _ => ?_)
    (kept_of_range ((endUseS_releases s p).trans (cleanup_releases _)) hpre.keptDesc)
    (endUse_noDangling hw hnd hb.1 hpre)
  · obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, hd⟩ := hw.places q pl r hq hp
    simp only [endUseS, hd, decide_eq_decide.2 (ownedIn_parent hw hq hp)]
  · have hnh : ¬ heldIn s.P p z.holder := fun hh => by
      have hd := dead_false hur
      simp only [endUseS, Bool.or_eq_false_iff, decide_eq_false_iff_not] at hd
      rw [hzh] at hh
      cases ho : pr.owner with
      | frame f => rw [ho] at hh; exact hh
      | place o => rw [ho] at hh; exact hd.2 (.direct hpr ho hh)
    rw [endUseS_get, hz]; simp [hnh]

/-- `free` preserves `WF3`, `I1`–`I4` and `NoDangling` (Spec 1 §70; the proof of `free_preserves`
without the anchor orders). -/
theorem free_base {k : K} {s s' : S3} {p auth : Nat} (hw : WF3 s) (hb : Inv3base s)
    (hnd : NoDangling s) (h : FreeStep k p auth s (.ok s')) :
    WF3 s' ∧ Inv3base s' ∧ NoDangling s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have hroot := rootPlace_of_ownedRoot hpre.ownedRoot
  refine releases_base hw hb.1 hb.2.1 (freeS_releases s p) rfl rfl rfl
    (fun q h => by simp only [freeS, Bool.or_eq_false_iff] at h; exact h.1)
    (fun q pl r hq hp => ?_) (free_anchors hb.2.2.1 hpre)
    (fun r i z pr hrp hur hz _ _ hpr hzh hzf => ?_)
    (kept_of_range ((freeS_releases s p).trans (cleanup_releases _)) hpre.keptDesc)
    (free_noDangling hw hnd hb.1 hpre)
  · obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hlt, -, hd⟩ := hw.places q pl r hq hp
    have hpo : parentOf s.P q = some r := by simp [parentOf, hq, hp]
    have hf : FreedPlace s.P p r ↔ FreedPlace s.P p q := by
      unfold FreedPlace
      rw [partOf_parent hpo hlt (lt_of_getElem? hpr) hroot.2, ownedIn_parent hw hq hp]
    simp only [freeS, hd, decide_eq_decide.2 hf]
  · have hnf : ¬ FreedPlace s.P p r := fun hf => by
      have := dead_false hur
      simp only [freeS, Bool.or_eq_false_iff, decide_eq_false_iff_not] at this
      exact this.2 hf
    have hc : ¬ ((∃ l ∈ z.footprint, FreedPlace s.P p l) ∨ heldIn s.P p z.holder) := by
      rintro (⟨l, hl, hfl⟩ | hh)
      · obtain ⟨-, -, hlr⟩ := mem_footprint.1 ((hzf l).1 hl)
        rcases hfl with hlp | hown
        · obtain rfl := rootOf_unique hrp hroot hlr hlp
          exact hnf (.inl ⟨hroot.1, .inl rfl⟩)
        · obtain ⟨pl, pr', hpl, hpr', ho⟩ := hw.ownerOf hlr
          exact hnf (.inr (ownedIn_of_owner hpl hpr' ho.symm hown))
      · rw [hzh] at hh
        cases ho : pr.owner with
        | frame f => rw [ho] at hh; exact hh
        | place o => rw [ho] at hh; exact hnf (.inr (.direct hpr ho hh))
    rw [freeS_get, hz]; simp [hc]

/-- Skeleton of a step that only releases authorities, shrinks usability and anchors (Spec 1
§69, §70 `ok` effects). -/
theorem skelV_releases {s : SC} {c : Nat} {t : S3} (hr : OnlyReleases (s.view c) t)
    (hP : t.P = s.P) (hu : ∀ q, t.Usable q → s.flat.Usable q)
    (hD : ∀ q, t.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ t.D q, x ∈ s.D q) : SkelV s t where
  P := hP
  len := by rw [hr.1]; exact Nat.le_refl _

    obtain ⟨y, hy, -, ho, -, hh, ha⟩ := hr.2 x y' hy'
    exact ⟨y, hy, ho, hh, ha⟩
  new := fun x y' hy' hx => absurd (lt_of_getElem? hy') (by rw [hr.1]; exact Nat.not_lt.2 hx)

/-! ## `alloc` (Spec 1 §71) -/

section AllocC

variable {k : K} {s : SC} {c pr ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape}

/-- Usability on the view is usability on the flat state (WC2 C2). -/
theorem view_usable_flat {q : Nat} (h : (s.view c).Usable q) : s.flat.Usable q :=
  (usable_mem_congr (t := s.flat) (F' := (s.view c).F) (fun _ => SC.mem_view_F)).1 h

/-- The anchor-order condition of an existing authority carries over `alloc` on the extended
ancestry (Spec 1 §44, §71 `ok`; mirrors `Alloc.effAnchorOK_old`). -/
theorem alloc_effAnchorOKC_old (hst : AllocStatic k (s.view c) pr ow ls) (hw : WF3 (s.view c))
    {x : Nat} {fd : Option Nat} (h : EffAnchorOKC s x fd) :
    EffAnchorOKC (s.set (allocEff (s.view c) ow ls)) x fd := by
  have he : (s.set (allocEff (s.view c) ow ls)).flat.effAnchor x = s.flat.effAnchor x := by
    show (allocEff (s.view c) ow ls).effAnchor x = (s.view c).effAnchor x
    simp only [S3.effAnchor, Alloc.ancs_eq hst]
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := effAnchorOKC_get h
  have hel : s.flat.effAnchor x < (s.view c).A.length := lt_of_getElem? hz
  have hz' : (s.set (allocEff (s.view c) ow ls)).A[(s.set (allocEff (s.view c) ow ls)).flat.effAnchor
      x]? = some z := by
    rw [he]; show (allocEff (s.view c) ow ls).A[s.flat.effAnchor x]? = _
    rw [Alloc.A_lt hel]; exact hz
  refine effAnchorOKC_of_same hz hz' ?_ (fun g f _ hg => hg) h
  cases hzh : z.holder with
  | frame f => rfl
  | place p =>
    cases hg : s.flat.pframe p with
    | none =>
      exfalso; unfold EffAnchorOKC at h; rw [hz] at h; simp [OptP, hzh, S3.hframe, hg] at h
    | some g =>
      have := Alloc.pframe_old (ls := ls) (ow := ow) hw (q := p) (pframe_iff.1 hg).lt
      show (allocEff (s.view c) ow ls).pframe p = s.flat.pframe p
      rw [this]; exact hg

/-- The new root authority of `alloc` satisfies the anchor-order condition for its holder on the
extended ancestry (Spec 1 §44, §71 `ok`; mirrors `Alloc.effAnchorOK_new`). -/
theorem alloc_effAnchorOKC_new (hst : AllocStatic k (s.view c) pr ow ls) (hw : WF3 (s.view c)) :
    EffAnchorOKC (s.set (allocEff (s.view c) ow ls)) s.A.length
      ((s.set (allocEff (s.view c) ow ls)).flat.pframe ow) := by
  have hA : (allocEff (s.view c) ow ls).A[(s.view c).A.length]? =
      some ⟨.modify, none, footprint (allocP (s.view c) ow ls) (s.view c).P.length, .place ow,
        true⟩ := by
    rw [Alloc.allocEff_A hst]; simp
  have he : (allocEff (s.view c) ow ls).effAnchor (s.view c).A.length = (s.view c).A.length := by
    simp only [S3.effAnchor, S3.ancs,
      chain_none (show (allocEff (s.view c) ow ls).org (s.view c).A.length = none by
        simp [S3.org, hA]),
      List.getLastD_nil]
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfF⟩ := hst.ownerUsable.frameOf
  have hpf : (allocEff (s.view c) ow ls).pframe ow = some f := by
    rw [Alloc.pframe_old hw hst.ownerUsable.lt]; exact pframe_iff.2 hf
  unfold EffAnchorOKC
  show OptP ((allocEff (s.view c) ow ls).A[(allocEff (s.view c) ow ls).effAnchor
    (s.view c).A.length]?) _ False
  rw [he, hA]
  simp only [OptP]
  show OptP ((allocEff (s.view c) ow ls).hframe (.place ow)) _ False
  simp only [S3.hframe, hpf, OptP]
  exact ⟨SC.mem_view_F.1 hfF, .inl rfl⟩

/-- `alloc` preserves `AnchorOrderC` (Spec 1 §44, §71 `ok`; mirrors `Alloc.anchorOrder`). -/
theorem alloc_anchorOrderC (hst : AllocStatic k (s.view c) pr ow ls) (hw : WF3 (s.view c))
    (hao : AnchorOrderC s) : AnchorOrderC (s.set (allocEff (s.view c) ow ls)) := by
  intro q hq x hx
  have hq' : (allocEff (s.view c) ow ls).Usable q :=
    (set_usable (fun _ => SC.mem_view_F)).1 hq
  change x ∈ (if (s.view c).P.length ≤ q then [] else (s.view c).D q) at hx
  by_cases hql : q < (s.view c).P.length
  · have hq0 := Alloc.usable_back hw hq' hql
    rw [if_neg (Nat.not_le.2 hql)] at hx
    show EffAnchorOKC _ x ((allocEff (s.view c) ow ls).pframe q)
    rw [Alloc.pframe_old hw hql]
    exact alloc_effAnchorOKC_old hst hw (hao q (view_usable_flat hq0) x hx)
  · rw [if_pos (Nat.le_of_not_lt hql)] at hx; cases hx

/-- `alloc` preserves `AnchorOrderHeldC` (Spec 1 §44, §71 `ok`; mirrors
`Alloc.anchorOrderHeld`). -/
theorem alloc_anchorOrderHeldC (hst : AllocStatic k (s.view c) pr ow ls) (hw : WF3 (s.view c))
    (haoh : AnchorOrderHeldC s) : AnchorOrderHeldC (s.set (allocEff (s.view c) ow ls)) := by
  intro q hq x y hx ya hh
  rcases Alloc.allocA_get hst hx with ⟨-, hx'⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · have hq0 : (s.view c).Usable q := by
      have := hw.holders x y hx' ya; rw [hh] at this; exact this
    show EffAnchorOKC _ x ((allocEff (s.view c) ow ls).pframe q)
    rw [Alloc.pframe_old hw hq0.lt]
    exact alloc_effAnchorOKC_old hst hw (haoh q (view_usable_flat hq0) x y hx' ya hh)
  · cases hh
    exact alloc_effAnchorOKC_new hst hw

end AllocC

/-! ## The operations run on the view (Spec 1 §60–§62, §66–§71, §74, §75) -/

/-- Every inherited operation other than O4, O5, O6, O7, O8, run on the view of a context,
preserves the re-indexed invariant (Spec 1 §57 re-indexed; WC2 C2, C20), under `DDSound`
(Spec 1 §80, used by `split`). -/
theorem viewOp_preserves {k : K} {s : SC} {c : Nat} {op : KernelOp} {t : S3} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hk : KInvCA s) (hop : op.Step k (s.view c) (.ok t)) (hnx : op ≠ .exit)
    (hne : ∀ ps ls, op ≠ .enter ps ls) (hnt : ∀ a b, op ≠ .transfer a b)
    (hnd : ∀ q x, op ≠ .depend q x) (hns : ∀ a p, op ≠ .store a p) : KInvCA (s.set t) := by
  obtain ⟨hw, hb, hd, hc, hh⟩ := view_facts hk c
  obtain ⟨hF, hn⟩ := viewOp_FnF hop hnx hne
  have hh' := op_preserves_heldAnchored hw hh hop
  cases op with
  | exit => exact absurd rfl hnx
  | enter => exact absurd rfl (hne _ _)
  | transfer => exact absurd rfl (hnt _ _)
  | depend => exact absurd rfl (hnd _ _)
  | store => exact absurd rfl (hns _ _)
  | derive src region m =>
    have h := hop
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop
    exact set_preserves hk hF hn
      (skelV_append fun y hy => by rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hy]; exact ⟨_, rfl⟩)
      (derive_preserves_wf3 hw h)
      ⟨derive_preserves_exclusivity hb.1 h, derive_preserves_i2 hb.2.1 h,
        derive_preserves_i3 hb.2.2.1 h, i4_always _⟩
      (derive_preserves_noDangling hd h) (derive_preserves_rootHeldConv hc h) hh'
  | split src rs =>
    have h := hop
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop
    exact set_preserves hk hF hn
      (skelV_append fun y hy => by obtain ⟨r, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hy; exact ⟨_, rfl⟩)
      (split_preserves_wf3 hw h)
      ⟨split_preserves_exclusivity hdd hb.1 h, split_preserves_i2 hb.2.1 h,
        split_preserves_i3 hb.2.2.1 h, i4_always _⟩
      (split_preserves_noDangling hd h) (split_preserves_rootHeldConv hc h) hh'
  | release a =>
    have h := hop
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop
    exact set_preserves hk hF hn skelV_release (release_preserves_wf3 hw h)

/-! ## `alloc` (Spec 1 §71) -/

section AllocC

variable {k : K} {s : SC} {c pr ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape}

/-- Usability on the view is usability on the flat state (WC2 C2). -/
theorem view_usable_flat {q : Nat} (h : (s.view c).Usable q) : s.flat.Usable q :=
  (usable_mem_congr (t := s.flat) (F' := (s.view c).F) (fun _ => SC.mem_view_F)).1 h

/-- The anchor-order condition of an existing authority carries over `alloc` on the extended
ancestry (Spec 1 §44, §71 `ok`; mirrors `Alloc.effAnchorOK_old`). -/
theorem alloc_effAnchorOKC_old (hst : AllocStatic k (s.view c) pr ow ls) (hw : WF3 (s.view c))
    {x : Nat} {fd : Option Nat} (h : EffAnchorOKC s x fd) :
    EffAnchorOKC (s.set (allocEff (s.view c) ow ls)) x fd := by
  have he : (s.set (allocEff (s.view c) ow ls)).flat.effAnchor x = s.flat.effAnchor x := by
    show (allocEff (s.view c) ow ls).effAnchor x = (s.view c).effAnchor x
    simp only [S3.effAnchor, Alloc.ancs_eq hst]
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := effAnchorOKC_get h
  have hel : s.flat.effAnchor x < (s.view c).A.length := lt_of_getElem? hz
  have hz' : (s.set (allocEff (s.view c) ow ls)).A[(s.set (allocEff (s.view c) ow ls)).flat.effAnchor
      x]? = some z := by
    rw [he]; show (allocEff (s.view c) ow ls).A[s.flat.effAnchor x]? = _
    rw [Alloc.A_lt hel]; exact hz
  refine effAnchorOKC_of_same hz hz' ?_ (fun g f _ hg => hg) h
  cases hzh : z.holder with
  | frame f => rfl
  | place p =>
    cases hg : s.flat.pframe p with
    | none =>
      exfalso; unfold EffAnchorOKC at h; rw [hz] at h; simp [OptP, hzh, S3.hframe, hg] at h
    | some g =>
      have := Alloc.pframe_old (ls := ls) (ow := ow) hw (q := p) (pframe_iff.1 hg).lt
      show (allocEff (s.view c) ow ls).pframe p = s.flat.pframe p
      rw [this]; exact hg

/-- The new root authority of `alloc` satisfies the anchor-order condition for its holder on the
extended ancestry (Spec 1 §44, §71 `ok`; mirrors `Alloc.effAnchorOK_new`). -/
theorem alloc_effAnchorOKC_new (hst : AllocStatic k (s.view c) pr ow ls) (hw : WF3 (s.view c)) :
    EffAnchorOKC (s.set (allocEff (s.view c) ow ls)) s.A.length
      ((s.set (allocEff (s.view c) ow ls)).flat.pframe ow) := by
  have hA : (allocEff (s.view c) ow ls).A[(s.view c).A.length]? =
      some ⟨.modify, none, footprint (allocP (s.view c) ow ls) (s.view c).P.length, .place ow,
        true⟩ := by
    rw [Alloc.allocEff_A hst]; simp
  have he : (allocEff (s.view c) ow ls).effAnchor (s.view c).A.length = (s.view c).A.length := by
    simp only [S3.effAnchor, S3.ancs,
      chain_none (show (allocEff (s.view c) ow ls).org (s.view c).A.length = none by
        simp [S3.org, hA]),
      List.getLastD_nil]
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfF⟩ := hst.ownerUsable.frameOf
  have hpf : (allocEff (s.view c) ow ls).pframe ow = some f := by
    rw [Alloc.pframe_old hw hst.ownerUsable.lt]; exact pframe_iff.2 hf
  unfold EffAnchorOKC
  show OptP ((allocEff (s.view c) ow ls).A[(allocEff (s.view c) ow ls).effAnchor
    (s.view c).A.length]?) _ False
  rw [he, hA]
  simp only [OptP]
  show OptP ((allocEff (s.view c) ow ls).hframe (.place ow)) _ False
  simp only [S3.hframe, hpf, OptP]
  exact ⟨SC.mem_view_F.1 hfF, .inl rfl⟩

/-- `alloc` preserves `AnchorOrderC` (Spec 1 §44, §71 `ok`; mirrors `Alloc.anchorOrder`). -/
theorem alloc_anchorOrderC (hst : AllocStatic k (s.view c) pr ow ls) (hw : WF3 (s.view c))
    (hao : AnchorOrderC s) : AnchorOrderC (s.set (allocEff (s.view c) ow ls)) := by
  intro q hq x hx
  have hq' : (allocEff (s.view c) ow ls).Usable q :=
    (set_usable (fun _ => SC.mem_view_F)).1 hq
  change x ∈ (if (s.view c).P.length ≤ q then [] else (s.view c).D q) at hx
  by_cases hql : q < (s.view c).P.length
  · have hq0 := Alloc.usable_back hw hq' hql
    rw [if_neg (Nat.not_le.2 hql)] at hx
    show EffAnchorOKC _ x ((allocEff (s.view c) ow ls).pframe q)
    rw [Alloc.pframe_old hw hql]
    exact alloc_effAnchorOKC_old hst hw (hao q (view_usable_flat hq0) x hx)
  · rw [if_pos (Nat.le_of_not_lt hql)] at hx; cases hx

/-- `alloc` preserves `AnchorOrderHeldC` (Spec 1 §44, §71 `ok`; mirrors
`Alloc.anchorOrderHeld`). -/
theorem alloc_anchorOrderHeldC (hst : AllocStatic k (s.view c) pr ow ls) (hw : WF3 (s.view c))
    (haoh : AnchorOrderHeldC s) : AnchorOrderHeldC (s.set (allocEff (s.view c) ow ls)) := by
  intro q hq x y hx ya hh
  rcases Alloc.allocA_get hst hx with ⟨-, hx'⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · have hq0 : (s.view c).Usable q := by
      have := hw.holders x y hx' ya; rw [hh] at this; exact this
    show EffAnchorOKC _ x ((allocEff (s.view c) ow ls).pframe q)
    rw [Alloc.pframe_old hw hq0.lt]
    exact alloc_effAnchorOKC_old hst hw (haoh q (view_usable_flat hq0) x y hx' ya hh)
  · cases hh
    exact alloc_effAnchorOKC_new hst hw

end AllocC

  obtain ⟨hF, hn⟩ := viewOp_FnF hop hnx hne

  | transfer => exact absurd rfl (hnt _ _)

      (derive_preserves_wf3 hw h)
      ⟨derive_preserves_exclusivity hb.1 h, derive_preserves_i2 hb.2.1 h,
        derive_preserves_i3 hb.2.2.1 h, i4_always _⟩

    exact set_preserves hk hF hn
      (skelV_append fun y hy => by obtain ⟨r, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hy; exact ⟨_, rfl⟩)
      (split_preserves_wf3 hw h)
      ⟨split_preserves_exclusivity hdd hb.1 h, split_preserves_i2 hb.2.1 h,
        split_preserves_i3 hb.2.2.1 h, i4_always _⟩

    exact set_preserves hk hF hn (skelV_same rfl rfl rfl rfl rfl) hw' hb'

  | pin p =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop
    obtain ⟨hw', hb'⟩ := pinEff_preserves_base p hw hb
    exact set_preserves hk hF hn (skelV_same rfl rfl rfl rfl rfl) hw' hb'
      (pinEff_preserves_noDangling p hd) (pinEff_preserves_rootHeldConv p hc) hh'
  | unpin o =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop
    obtain ⟨hw', hb'⟩ := unpinEff_preserves_base o hw hb
    exact set_preserves hk hF hn (skelV_same rfl rfl rfl rfl rfl) hw' hb'
